lines: Count the toys: your child touches each thing, and Pibbo counts along.
One touch, one number. Each toy says the next number and shows it, marked by shape as well as colour. Touch it again, and the count doesn't move.
On a phone or a wide desktop it's the same round, with more room and no more things.
When every toy is counted, Pibbo asks how many, and offers numerals to choose from.
A wrong answer is a chance to try again. Nothing is taken away: Pibbo counts the toys again, and your child chooses again.
The right one earns a short yes, and the next round is ready straight away.
The tests prove it: one touch, one number, a kind retry, and nothing to scroll.
Pibbo helps young children learn to count and to sound out words.
A child opens it on whatever screen is to hand, picks an activity, and plays: counting the things in front of them, and saying each sound of a word and blending the sounds into the word.
